story.text: Mr. Bennet is alarmed: “I know your disposition, {LIZZY}. I know that you could be neither happy nor respectable, unless you truly {ESTEEMED} your husband.” She tells him all that Darcy has done, and he is won over. Mrs. Bennet, hearing the news, sits quite {STILL}, unable to utter a {SYLLABLE}. Then: “How {RICH} and how great you will be! What pin-money, what {JEWELS}! A {HOUSE} in town! Ten {THOUSAND} a year!”
story.caption: Unable to utter a syllable
